periods.riskManagerRationale: Case-specific bounded debt-population uncertainty. Treat the entire displayed opaque caption balance as a possible incremental financing exposure, rather than claim any component is non-financing. Exposure relative to reported borrowing, assets and equity is limited in this HPG period; positive reported CFO exceeds the entire balance. Issuer borrowing/current-portion and liability reconciliations already retained support the reported population; no positively identified financing outside borrowing captions is omitted. This assessment concerns adequacy of reported-debt population with a disclosed sensitivity only; it does not establish covenant headroom, cash availability, normalized EBITDA, debt-service capacity, an investment decision or exhaustive debt absence. Unclassified balances remain nonzero UNKNOWN and comprehensive debt stays unverified. No universal threshold is created.
assessmentLimits: Independent qualitative risk judgment, not an issuer accounting fact
No claim concerning unrecorded/contingent financing completeness
